scope: QEMU ET/LV/LT HIGH/LOW at VGA heights 8/14/16. Missing-file preparation preserves the active page; opened malformed resources invalidate the prepared slot and reject selection. Country state and actual visible glyph bytes remain intact. Valid prepare/select restores DOS/DISPLAY agreement without reboot. No change to DISPLAY semantics. Does not qualify installed paths, real-BIOS resource failures or complete application/file workflows.

driver_contract.missing_file: MODE opens the file before DES_START, so open failure does not invalidate the prepared slot.
driver_contract.malformed_file: DISPLAY HANDLE_WRITE_ERROR invalidates requested slots and marks the active page inactive if no longer prepared.
